title: Your quest, scripted.
status: Enquiries only. Not yet open for bookings.
intro: Got a what-if you want to play? I script custom Parallel Quests for Xenoverse 2 on PC. This is a paid service once bookings open, and it’s separate from my free quest downloads. For now, send me your idea and I’ll tell you if I can build it.

service.name: Custom Parallel Quest
service.tagline: A playable quest built from your idea, scripted and tested by me.

includes.text: Quest design from your idea: story, stages, enemies and allies
Scripting: dialogue, events, win and lose conditions, rewards set up
Built with existing game characters, your CaC, or free mods whose authors allow it
Tested on my setup, delivered as an .x2m with install notes
A short bug-fix window after delivery

provide.text: Your idea, characters and any reference pictures
Whether it stays private or can be released free for everyone, with credit to you
Your setup: PC, XV2 Patcher version, and whether you use Revamp

excludes.text: Selling or reuploading official game files, ripped models or other modders’ work
Console versions, online-only or cheat content

facts.label: Price
facts.value: On request. No payment is taken through this site.

rules: Fan-made work: you’re paying for my time and skills, not for Dragon Ball or Xenoverse assets. Every asset author gets credited, and I only use mods whose authors allow it. Not affiliated with Bandai Namco, Toei Animation or the Revamp team.

steps.title: Send your enquiry
steps.text: Fill in the form below. It writes the message for you to copy and send me on Discord.

steps.title: I reply to talk scope
steps.text: I’ll tell you if I can build it, what it would involve and roughly how long it would take.

steps.title: Nothing is booked or paid yet
steps.text: Commissions aren’t open. No booking is made and no payment is taken through this site.

button_note: Opens the Xeno Time Patrol Discord. Paste your enquiry in a direct message to Xeno Trunks. Never send passwords or payment details.

form.title: Send an enquiry
form.intro: Takes about two minutes. Nothing is sent from this page: it writes your enquiry so you can copy it and send it to me yourself.
form.agree_text: I understand this is fan-made work. No official game files, ripped models or other modders’ work will be sold, and nothing is booked or paid yet.
